event: Vermont Green FC defeated Flint City Bucks 2-1 to win the 2026 USL League Two championship, becoming the first back-to-back champion in league history and finishing the season undefeated.
Flint City Bucks lost the 2026 USL League Two Final 2-1 to Vermont Green FC at Atwood Stadium in Flint, denied a league-record fifth title.
Flint City Bucks secured their fourth consecutive Great Lakes Division title and reached their seventh USL League Two Final in club history.
Vermont Green FC finished the 2026 season with a record of 18 wins and one draw, their second consecutive undefeated campaign.
Deportivo Rose City advanced to the UPSL Spring 2026 National Finals for the first time in club history with a 2-1 win over Next Level Soccer in the West Region Final.
Miami United FC advanced to the UPSL Spring 2026 National Finals via 6-5 penalty shootout over SCU Heat after a 1-1 draw in the South Region Final.
Central Kansas United defeated West Texas Rush 2-1 in Abilene, Texas to win the UPSL Central Region Final and qualify for the National Finals.
New York Renegades FC qualified for the UPSL Spring 2026 National Finals as East Region champions, setting up a rematch of the 2025 Fall Finals against Miami United FC.

Deportivo Rose City are one of four clubs competing for the 2026 UPSL Spring National Championship, with the winner and runner-up both earning direct entry into the 2027 US Open Cup Tournament Proper.
Miami United FC are one of four clubs competing for the 2026 UPSL Spring National Championship, with both finalist clubs earning direct entry into the 2027 US Open Cup Tournament Proper.
Central Kansas United are one of four UPSL National Finalists, competing for a championship and a direct 2027 US Open Cup berth — which would mark the club's first-ever USOC appearance.
New York Renegades FC enter the UPSL National Finals as defending Fall champions, targeting a second 2027 US Open Cup automatic berth alongside whatever club wins the Spring title.
Fort Wayne FC hold the longest active unbeaten run in USL League One 2026 at seven games (since April 11).
Corpus Christi FC remain winless across all ten of their 2026 USL League One matches — the longest active winless run in the league.
Athletic Club Boise drew the 2026 USL League One season-high attendance of 7,227 for their 2-1 home win over Chattanooga Red Wolves SC.
Westchester SC are on a four-game losing streak (since April 18) in the 2026 USL League One season.
Charlotte Independence are on a four-game winning run (since May 6) in the 2026 USL League One season.
Sporting Cascades FC joined USL League One for the 2026 season as the successor club to Lane United FC, which disbanded after 12 seasons.
